summary: feat(settings): switch the integration in-app instead of hard-reloading
description:
Because:

- A Glean event queued before an in-app integration switch was recorded
  with the new integration's client ID, service and attribution.

This commit:

- Captures the integration when a Glean event is emitted and passes it
  to initMetrics.
- Adds a unit test for an event queued before setIntegration.

Closes FXA-14791
